build_optimizer: build an AdamW optimizer with separate learning rates for backbone, text encoder, and transformer parameters
update_ema: apply exponential moving average updates to a model's weights using a decay factor
adjust_learning_rate_step: adjust the optimizer learning rate using a step schedule that divides lr by 10 after lr_drop epochs
adjust_learning_rate_linear_warmup: adjust the optimizer learning rate using a linear warmup then decay schedule for the text encoder
adjust_learning_rate_multistep: adjust the optimizer learning rate using a multistep schedule that halves lr every 50 epochs after lr_drop
